usage_rules.headings: Uppercase, tracking-tight, leading-none. Use for page titles and major stats.
usage_rules.body: High legibility, relaxed leading. Use for tables and forms.

primary.description: Metallic Gold - Use for Brand Identity, Certificates, and Primary CTAs

secondary.description: Electric Cyan - Use for Data Visualization, Active States, and Dashboard Accents

dashboard.rules: Dense, no jagged bottoms, 100% height utilization.

cards.dashboard: Flat background (#0A0A0A), 1px border (#27272A), no shadow. Hover: Border becomes #00F0FF (Cyan).

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-[#F3E5AB] transition-all duration-300 sharp-edges
buttons.secondary: border border-[#27272A] text-white hover:border-[#D4AF37] hover:text-[#D4AF37] bg-transparent

inputs.style: bg-[#121212] border-[#27272A] text-white focus:border-[#D4AF37] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D4AF37] h-12 rounded-none

tables.header: uppercase text-xs tracking-widest text-neutral-500 border-b border-[#27272A]

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the main background to prevent banding.
visual_enhancers.borders: Tracing Beam effect on active warranty cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Glow effects instead of drop shadows. box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1).

hero_bg.usage: Login Page Background, Public Verification Hero

assets.icons: Phosphor Icons (Regular weight for UI, Duotone for Dashboard Stats)

libraries.charts: Recharts (Customized with Electric Cyan and Gold strokes)

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Control Room' grid for the Admin Dashboard. It must feel dense and data-rich.
Use the 'Tetris' grid for the Public Verification page to make it feel like a premium brand experience.
The 'Create Warranty' form should feel like a high-end configuration tool, not a tax form. Use steps or clear sections.
The Warranty Certificate must be printable. Design a specific print-friendly view.
Use the Gold color (#D4AF37) sparingly for high-value actions. Use Cyan (#00F0FF) for data.
Ensure the 'Dark Mode' is deep and rich, not just grey. Use the #050505 background.
Add a 'Tracing Beam' border effect to the active warranty card in the dashboard.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Do not use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Chivo'.
Do not center-align everything. Use asymmetry.
Always add hover states to interactive elements.
